node.notes: Exact minor/patch version is resolved at image build time from the NodeSource 26.x channel, which publishes a single `nodistro` suite and so also installs on Trixie (Phase 14) without a channel change. Only used as the ExecJS runtime for coffee-script and terser. Node 26 enters Active LTS on 2026-10-28. Other lines on 2026-10-25: 24 Krypton (Maintenance LTS, EOL 2028-04-30), 22 Jod (Maintenance, EOL 2027-04-30), 20 (EOL 2026-04-30, what the app ran until Phase 6). Node 27 (2027-04, LTS 2027-10) is Phase 20 and optional.

yarn.source: Phase 6 (PR #223) dropped `npm install -g yarn` from all three Dockerfiles and deleted bin/yarn
yarn.notes: Nothing in the repo has a package.json, yarn.lock or node_modules; the config/initializers/assets.rb node_modules load-path comment was left as-is.
